title: Torsional Compliance
text: Parallel spring-damper, 3 inputs, 4 outputs; {Port Configuration} sets the configuration, {Output Info bus} sets the selection, {Torsional stiffness, k} sets the inertia 1e4, {Torsional damping, b} sets the damping 1e2, {Initial deflection, theta_o} sets the angular, {Initial velocity difference, domega_o} sets the angular and {Damping cut-off frequency, omega_c} sets the frequency. Values come from the instance.
